objective: Prove full uniform-cube Fourier entropy-influence with a finite dimension-independent constant, or rigorously disprove it with actual Boolean functions having unbounded H/I.

state.worker_output: Unique immutable run directories; do not overwrite shared indices or another stream's output.

selection: Resume a productive unfinished packet with its exact gap and last derivation.
Consume a useful new dependency or review objection.
Otherwise choose the highest-priority ready packet in the same stream.
If access or a dependency blocks it, do independent permitted FEI work in that stream.
dispatch.assistance: Source-bound handoff to an existing stream; do not create new schedules or workers.
dispatch.workflow_dependencies: Advisory and may have feedback loops.
dispatch.proof_dependencies: Exact claim versions actually used; must be acyclic and have stated acceptance or conditional status.

report_fields: exact target, quantifiers, hypotheses and units
sources actually read, revisions and theorem locators
complete derivation or exact first unsupported line
executed validation with domain, arithmetic, commands and outputs
proof dependencies and changed downstream conclusions
one next mathematical action and independent reviewer
actual persistence receipts or precise save blocker
required_per_run.legacy_runs: Preserve originals lacking PROGRESS.json; B20 may adopt them in the index with explicit provenance, without rewriting history.

completion.baseline: Accept a finite source-complete baseline once; reopen only for a specific correction or new application.
completion.research: An honest final gap handoff can be a complete artifact while its mathematical target remains open.
completion.full_fei: Requires the full all-dimensional theorem or an actual Boolean unbounded-ratio family; a status field cannot establish either.

review.when_cap_reached: Finish, repair, verify, or independently review before opening another broad candidate.
review.major_candidate: Two substantive independent reconstructions of the full dependency chain.
review.exploration: May proceed conditionally; do not block every inference on two complete reviews.
review.contributor_conflict: A reviewer who supplies a substantive repair is a contributor to that version and recuses from independent acceptance.
review.independence: Different proof reconstruction, representation, or implementation for the critical claim.
review.queue_count: Count every source-complete pending candidate in CLAIM_REGISTRY, including unadopted/unmapped live outputs in PACKET_STATUS; do not rely on packet counters alone.

stagnation.identity: Stable gap ID across notation and equivalent reformulations.
stagnation.response: Diagnose the exact bottleneck, change mathematical mechanism or a substantive hypothesis, or extract a narrower theorem; preserve failed attempts.

steps: Record the exact false statement, version and actual witness.
Mark dependents BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY or CONDITIONAL until repaired.
Route original source-bound correction to named consumers.
Require consumers to record the repaired substitution in their next substantive report.

stages: exact Boolean spectrum and influence verification
rigorous sign certificate or analytic argument
separate finite-to-infinite or continuum bridge when needed
compute.stop_precision: As soon as the required sign is rigorous.
compute.resource_claims: Record observed runtime and availability; do not infer billing, token prices, continuous execution or additional capacity.

checkpoints.goal: Baseline complete; exact unpaid gaps and nonduplicated packets; do not restart recovered work.
Quantitative restricted lemmas or rigorous route obstructions.
Reallocate within existing capacity using actual mathematical progress.
Complete strongest surviving mechanisms and substantial class results.
Integrated independent review, continuing rolling reviews already begun.
Accepted proof package, failed-route archive, exact open frontier and continuation.

b20_coverage: Review all 100 A-packets and every report element.
Identify unattended high-priority obligations; route within existing streams.
Propagate refutations and review objections with exact versions.
Record evidence of completion, not just receipts or configuration.
Produce a substantive mathematical synthesis or derivation in its own run.

supplement.role_labels: F groups neither replace B identities/A assignments nor add workers.
recovered_seed_interfaces: normalized prior mixture of complete references
effective-piece rank bound under disjoint physical support and fiber-antichain hypotheses
fixed spectral Renyi order below one point-defect obstruction

schedule_deployment_status: PROTOCOL_PREPARED; see latest verification manifest for actual prompt readback.

compatibility.navigation: TASK_EXECUTION.md and STREAM_NEXT_ACTIONS.json route to this protocol and the current matrix.
compatibility.state: PACKET_STATUS.json is canonical. PACKET_PROGRESS.json is a B20-maintained compatibility view preserving prior evidence.
compatibility.run_delta: PROGRESS.json is canonical per-run progress. Save PACKET_DELTA.json with the same content and packet_ids=[primary packet_id] for existing consumers. Accept legacy PACKET_DELTA-only runs without rewriting originals.
compatibility.precedence: Current audited mathematical scope, source corrections and actual claim versions govern; legacy initial defaults are advisory.
